cards.hint: One event happening immediately after another
examples: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
No sooner did we leave than it started to rain.
The more you practice, the more confident you become.
The more he earned, the more he spent.

cards.hint: Adding emphasis with two related facts
examples: She not only sings but also writes her own songs.
It was not only cheap but also well made.
